## Class Questions

- What do you want to talk about today?

## Basic Concepts

- What is organizational conflict? What are the "Three I's of Conflict"?
- What are the five phases of conflict? Discuss a conflict you have experienced and whether it followed this pattern.
- What are the five conflict styles from the Thomas-Kilmann model? What two dimensions do they vary on?
- What are the benefits and drawbacks of each style? 

## Basic Concepts (cont.)

- What is the difference between distributive and integrative negotiation? Can we always use integrative negotiation?
- What is the difference between negotiation and mediation?
- How do personal, relational, and cultural factors influence conflict management?

## Reading Review Questions

- If collaboration is considere an effective way to manage conflict why do so many people choose avoidance or competition instead? 
- How can a manager tell the difference between someone with a real disagreement and someone who just likes stirring up conflict?
- How can organizations encourage employees to speak openly about disagreements and challenge decisions without creating a negative work environment or damaging relationships with supervisors?

## Reading Review Questions (cont.)

- Is conflict necessary? When can conflict do more harm than good? How can we tell the difference?
- Is this related to game theory?
- What is a boundary spanner role?
- How would an intergroup conflict look if individuals have opposing views and agree with the group their group is in conflict with. Would that be considered disloyal?
